title: step-params/1: the parameters of one Flow step with their defaults and the --set keys
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli flow defaults STEP --json` (plus the citation member) and of the `lr_flow_defaults` op (same bytes in the site and the app): one entry per parameter of the step, then those of each algorithm, read from the step/1 descriptor. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/step/defaults.rs.

instance.description: Instance name used in set_key: the last part of the step id, as `flow steps --template` names it.

presets.description: Only when the step has named presets: the values each one writes with `--set INSTANCE.preset=ID`, one entry per parameter it sets.

set_key.description: INSTANCE.NAME of `--set`. For an algorithm parameter, select the algorithm first (`INSTANCE.algorithm=ID`).

type.description: pair: two numbers, `--set key=A,B`; choice: one value of `enum`.

default.description: The value the step uses when the parameter is not set; null when it has none.

when_empty.description: Set when default is null: `off` the rule is not applied, `estimated` the step measures the value and writes it with its proof.

algorithm.description: Id of the algorithm the parameter belongs to; null for the step's own.
